final: WITH j AS (SELECT a.translink AS tl, t.tradekind AS tk FROM advancedbehavior a JOIN transactionrecord r ON r.transreg = a.translink JOIN trader t ON t.tradereg = r.trdref), p AS (SELECT tl, tk, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM j GROUP BY tl, tk), s AS (SELECT tl, tk, cnt, CAST(cnt AS REAL) / SUM(cnt) OVER (PARTITION BY tk) AS share FROM p), m AS (SELECT *, AVG(share) OVER (PARTITION BY tk) AS avgshare FROM s) SELECT tk AS tradekind, AVG(cnt) AS avg_count, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(share - avgshare) AS avg_excess FROM m WHERE share >= avgshare GROUP BY tk
